messages:
elaine: Quick sync — need to finalize field pilot acceptance criteria for BYOK keystore + audit retention. Can we lock this by EOD? cc @kevin @sam :alarm_clock:
kevin: ok. what's the minimal criteria from security side?
sam: From sec: 1) KMS handshake succeed for tenant test keys, 2) Audit events emitted for every encrypt/decrypt, 3) Evidence export format matches legal schema.
elaine: adding ops asks: 1) retention TTL configurable per-tenant, 2) ability to suspend retention for legal hold, 3) alerting when audit ingestion lags > 5m.
tia: Oncall: alerting needs runbook + severity mapping. propose: lag 5-15m P2, >15m P1. Also need synthetic events to validate pipeline.
marta: Legal: evidence export must include chain-of-custody header + signed checksum. retention default 365 days but we need option for 7y for finserv.
kevin: engineering constraints: KV store index can't hold >90d hot index without cost hit. propose hot index 90d, cold archive accessible via export. Also need prefix caching excluded from audit logs? clarify: do we log cache hits?
sam: we must log cache hits if they change request semantics. If it's purely optimization, annotate but don't include payload.
elaine: decision proposal (vote):
- pilot acceptance = KMS handshake + audit ingestion for canary tenant + export run successful
- retention policy: tenant-configurable default 365d, hot index 90d
- alerting thresholds: P2 5-15m, P1 >15m
- legal hold suspend retention API included
kevin: fine but add 'no plaintext keys persisted' check to acceptance
tia: +1 on runbook and synthetic test harness
marta: +1 on chain-of-custody + checksum
sam: I'll own SOC2 mapping for events (write down mapping doc)
elaine: ok assigning owners: sam -> SOC2 mapping & KMS attestation; kevin -> audit pipeline + hot/cold layout; tia -> runbook + alerts; marta -> export contract; I'll consolidate into PR by 12:00 PST.
infra-bot: deploy scheduled: canary-config applied to tenant-alpha at 2024-09-02T15:00Z
kevin: noted. will add unit smoke test:
```
# smoke test
curl -X POST /v1/keystore/handshake -d '{"tenant":"alpha","key_ref":"customer-k"}'
# expect 200 and event: audit.event.kms.handshake
```
elaine: thanks team. If no objections I'll mark this thread as decision and move to roadmap epic. :thumbsup:
